title: lastrea deparioides
intro: Lastrea deparioides, commonly known as the Deparioid fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is native to parts of Asia and is known for its medicinal properties. The Deparioid fern has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
